title: Marketing-Bench: Evaluating Frontier Models and Agents on Real-World Marketing Capabilities
abstract: arXiv:2611.32012v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: As frontier AI models and agents are deployed more broadly in the real world, marketing is emerging as one of their largest applications. Marketing teams use AI models to produce brand assets like website copy and social media posts, while consumers' agents autonomously discover products, research purchases, and navigate websites. However, evaluating marketing capability is difficult because unlike areas like software development, customer support, or legal review where ground truth is more objectively defined, marketing is subjective, and output quality is judged based on taste and brand. We introduce Marketing-Bench, the first open-source marketing benchmark, which pairs discriminative tasks (detecting brand anomalies) with generative tasks (remediation), while keeping answers verifiable. Marketing-Bench tests five key pillars: factuality, consistency, coherence, structure, and brand voice, all crucial elements for good brand content o

translated_title: Marketing-Bench：评估前沿模型与智能体在真实世界营销能力上的表现
translated_abstract: 随着前沿AI模型和智能体在现实世界中被更广泛地部署，营销正成为其最大的应用领域之一。营销团队使用AI模型来制作品牌资产，如网站文案和社交媒体帖子，而消费者的智能体则自主发现产品、调研购买决策并浏览网站。然而，评估营销能力十分困难，因为与软件开发、客户支持或法律审查等真值定义较为客观的领域不同，营销是主观的，其输出质量取决于品味和品牌调性。我们提出了Marketing-Bench，这是首个开源的营销基准，它将判别式任务（检测品牌异常）与生成式任务（修复问题）配对，同时保持答案可验证。Marketing-Bench测试五个关键维度：事实性、一致性、连贯性、结构和品牌语调，这些都是优质品牌内容的关键要素。
tldr: 该论文提出了首个开源营销基准Marketing-Bench，通过将品牌异常检测（判别式任务）与修复（生成式任务）配对且保持答案可验证，从事实性、一致性、连贯性、结构和品牌语调五个维度评估AI模型与智能体的真实营销能力。
en_tdlr: Marketing-Bench, the first open-source marketing benchmark, pairs discriminative brand-anomaly detection with generative remediation while keeping answers verifiable, evaluating AI models and agents across five pillars: factuality, consistency, coherence, structure, and brand voice.
